title: Sanctity of Life
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: If a child speaks of wanting to hurt himself or someone else, stop the lesson plan and follow the safeguarding policy.

skills.key_step: The child says God is the only source of life (Genesis 1:27, 9:6), that we must not take human life (Exodus 20:13), names causes of violence against life (anger, revenge, drugs), and ways to cope with hard feelings (walk away, breathe, talk to a trusted adult, pray).

floor.prerequisite: Knows how to cope with anger.
floor.question: What does Ephesians 4:26 say about anger?
floor.answer: Do not sin when you are angry

representations: a calm-down plan: stop, breathe, walk away, tell
steps: Every person is made in God's image.
When angry: stop, breathe, walk away, tell.
contexts: news of violence in the community

board.do: Write Exodus 20:13 and draw a calm-down plan.

board.say: What can you do when you feel very angry?

board.do: Wait for the child to name a safe way.
Write a trusted adult's name at the end.

misconceptions.ask: What does it mean that human life is sacred?

listen_for: Hit back so that the other child learns
misconceptions.ask: What is a safe way to cope with anger?
According to Christian teaching, who is the source of life?
Whose life is sacred in God's eyes?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 1:27: every person is made in God's image. Name people the world may overlook.

checks.question: Who is the source of life?
Name a safe way to cope with anger.
checks.answer: Walk away and tell a trusted adult
